headline: Mistakes to Avoid After a House Fire
articleBody: When your home has been hit by fire, it's a super stressful time, and it's easy to make choices that might actually complicate things further down the line. Avoiding a few common missteps can save you headaches and heartache. One big mistake is trying to clean up soot or water damage yourself. Without proper equipment and training, you could spread contaminants or cause more damage, plus it's a health risk. Another common error is delaying contacting your insurance company. The sooner you report the incident, the quicker your claim can be processed and the restoration can begin. Don't discard damaged items too quickly either; your insurance adjuster will need to see them to properly assess your claim. Also, avoid turning on utilities like electricity or gas before a professional inspection—this can be extremely dangerous. Finally, don't just pick the first restoration company you find; get multiple estimates and check credentials. We encourage clients to make informed decisions. When in doubt, call First To Respond Restoration. We’re here to help assess the damage and guide you through the best next steps.
